tonight.headline: Three coin flips still unset — Tuten's locks Thursday
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten, still in the FLEX, did not practise all week and is a game-time decision for Thursday at Baltimore; he locks at the 19:15 CDMX kickoff. Garrett Wilson, in a WR slot, entered the concussion protocol today. Rashee Rice and George Pickens, the two receivers who would replace him, were both limited Wednesday.
As set Bloodsports project 130.6 against Jackrabbits' 124.0; the projection lineup is 133.5. Make the three swaps, Gordon for Tuten first — the lineup has not changed since this morning.

case.label: Their lineup
case.body: Jackrabbits start Henry and Zay Flowers behind rookie Joe Fagnano Thursday — against your Jaguars D/ST, 10-point road favourites (WagerTalk 4 Nov). Ashton Jeanty is in their FLEX after two touches in Week 8; Las Vegas are ready to give Mike Washington Jr. more (Bleacher Report 4 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Bloodsports set the projection lineup and still lose by more than 10 — then it was the roster, not the lineup.

doFirst.title: Start Gordon in the FLEX, bench Tuten

case.label: The flip
case.body: Gordon 16.5, Tuten 15.4: inside two points. Take the projection; no thesis.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Tuten did not practise Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday; officially a game-time decision (NBC, CBS 4 Nov). Gordon is Miami's lead back, 19 and 25 carries the last two weeks (archive), and both his backups were on Wednesday's report. Once Jacksonville kick off Thursday, Tuten is locked in.

doFirst.title: Start Rice, bench Garrett Wilson
doFirst.subtitle: 13.9 to 12.8 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Rice 13.9, Wilson 12.8: inside two points.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Rice was limited Wednesday, called maintenance (AtoZ 4 Nov); Wilson entered the concussion protocol (ESPN 4 Nov 17:53Z). Neither is the reason; the number is.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson outscores Rice in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Likely at TE, bench Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: 12.8 to 12.1 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Likely 12.8, Loveland 12.1: inside one point.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Loveland drew 9 targets Monday with Kmet out (NBC 3 Nov); Likely goes to Philadelphia, 2nd-toughest on TEs, where the Eagles now start Joe Milton III (ESPN 4 Nov). Matchups are not overrides.

case.label: Falsified if

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — check Sun 8 Nov 10:30 CDMX
doFirst.title: If Rice is inactive Sunday, start Pickens
doFirst.subtitle: Limited Wednesday as maintenance; Wilson, the other option, is in the concussion protocol.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Hamstring/knee; limited Wednesday, described as planned maintenance (AtoZ, NBC 4 Nov). He returned in Week 8 with 8 targets (archive).

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Pickens 13.1, limited Wednesday with the hamstring and shoulder but 'moving well' (NBC 4 Nov 22:01Z). Wilson 12.8 is in the concussion protocol, so Pickens is the cover either way.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Rice is active and Pickens would have outscored him (archive) — the contingency only fires on an inactive.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: A free agent here — no priority — but the split was Kubiak's design, not an injury.

case.label: The player
case.body: 25 carries for 83 and 0 targets in his first start; Jeanty 2 touches. Kubiak: 'We just wanted to give Mike a few more opportunities.' ESPN's Graziano says Las Vegas will give Washington more if Jeanty does not respond (Bleacher Report 4 Nov).

case.label: Why not
case.body: Bloodsports carry five backs, and Marks — the obvious drop — now has Houston's whole backfield with Montgomery ruled out (NBC 4 Nov).

case.label: When to act
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco, and Montgomery back in Houston — then a free-agent add for Marks.

doNotChase.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
doNotChase.lead: Dropped this morning — don't claim him back.

case.body: 2 catches for 6 on 5 targets in Week 8 with Penix 8-of-24, 4 INT (FFB ~2 Nov); a third tight end behind Likely and Loveland. Reclaiming him costs IPADE priority for the season and reverses today's move.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely or Loveland hurt for weeks.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: An Irving injury.

case.label: The new fact

case.label: What would change it
